description: Test suite for the Subscription feature in ERPNext, including setup functions, multiple test cases for subscription lifecycle, billing, cancellation, and multicurrency handling.

classes.name: TestSubscription
classes.description: Unit test class for testing various aspects of the Subscription functionality, including creation, billing, cancellation, and edge cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating subscription plans and parties.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_with_trial_with_correct_period
methods.description: Tests creation of a subscription with a trial period and verifies correct period setup.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_without_trial_with_correct_period
methods.description: Tests creation of a subscription without a trial period and verifies default values.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_trial_with_wrong_dates
methods.description: Ensures validation error is raised when trial start and end dates are inconsistent.

methods.name: test_create_subscription_multi_with_different_billing_fails
methods.description: Checks that creating a subscription with multiple plans of different billing intervals fails.

methods.name: test_invoice_is_generated_at_end_of_billing_period
methods.description: Verifies invoice generation at the end of billing period and status update.

methods.name: test_status_goes_back_to_active_after_invoice_is_paid
methods.description: Tests that subscription status reverts to active after invoice is paid.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancel_after_grace_period
methods.description: Checks cancellation of subscription after grace period.

methods.name: test_subscription_unpaid_after_grace_period
methods.description: Verifies unpaid status after grace period elapses.

methods.name: test_subscription_invoice_days_until_due
methods.description: Tests calculation of days until invoice is due.

methods.name: test_subscription_is_past_due_doesnt_change_within_grace_period
methods.description: Ensures status remains 'Past Due' within the grace period.

methods.name: test_subscription_remains_active_during_invoice_period
methods.description: Verifies subscription remains active during current invoice period.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancelation
methods.description: Tests cancelation of a subscription.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancellation_invoices
methods.description: Checks invoice creation and prorata calculation upon cancellation.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancellation_invoices_with_prorata_false
methods.description: Verifies invoice total when prorate is disabled during cancellation.

methods.name: test_subscription_cancellation_invoices_with_prorata_true
methods.description: Verifies invoice total with prorate enabled during cancellation.

methods.name: test_subcription_cancellation_and_process
methods.description: Tests cancellation and subsequent processing of a subscription.

methods.name: test_subscription_restart_and_process
methods.description: Tests restarting a canceled subscription and processing.

methods.name: test_subscription_unpaid_back_to_active
methods.description: Checks status transition from Unpaid to Active after payment.

methods.name: test_restart_active_subscription
methods.description: Ensures validation error when restarting an active subscription.

methods.name: test_subscription_invoice_discount_percentage
methods.description: Verifies invoice discount percentage application.

methods.name: test_subscription_invoice_discount_amount
methods.description: Verifies invoice discount amount application.

methods.name: test_prepaid_subscriptions
methods.description: Tests behavior of prepaid vs non-prepaid subscriptions.

methods.name: test_prepaid_subscriptions_with_prorate_true
methods.description: Verifies prorate calculation for prepaid subscriptions.

methods.name: test_subscription_with_follow_calendar_months
methods.description: Checks invoice end date when following calendar months.

methods.name: test_subscription_generate_invoice_past_due
methods.description: Verifies invoice creation for past due subscriptions.

methods.name: test_subscription_without_generate_invoice_past_due
methods.description: Ensures no additional invoice is generated when past due invoices are disabled.

methods.name: test_multicurrency_subscription
methods.description: Tests creation and processing of a multicurrency subscription and verifies invoice currency.
